correctness.rationale: Finite-set Poisson-union inversion is derived from exact avoidance probabilities. A centre-spin/arm-spin decomposition proves the P_k partition functions. Exact integer arithmetic confirms the factor H=-t^8(t-1)^4(t+1)^16 Q28 and the binomially transformed polynomial R has precisely one sign change. Descartes plus continuity proves the unique sign transition. Exhaustive 512-state enumeration at five temperatures reproduces direct inversion to numerical precision; no experimental extrapolation is needed.

value.rationale: The 3x3 grid is the first square grid with a fully interior four-neighbour vertex. The center-plus-four-arm Poisson atom is a naturally motivated four-way interaction probe, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The exact, unique 0.23285659... threshold gives a sharp finite-volume no-go interval and a change of sign of this specific witness, a meaningful benchmark for finite-size Poisson representability, while carefully not overstating sufficiency at larger beta.
